meta.description: Sends multi-channel notifications (Telegram, Slack, Email, WhatsApp for hot leads) when new leads are generated or human escalation requested.

_setupNotes.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: Create bot via @BotFather on Telegram. Get token. Start the bot or add to a group to get CHAT_ID.
_setupNotes.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: Your Telegram user ID or group chat ID. Send a message to @userinfobot to get your ID.
_setupNotes.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: Create an Incoming Webhook in your Slack workspace: api.slack.com/apps → Create App → Incoming Webhooks
_setupNotes.SALES_TEAM_EMAIL: Email address(es) to notify — separate multiple with commas in n8n Email Send node
_setupNotes.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID: Optional — only needed for WhatsApp alerts. Get from Twilio console.
_setupNotes.TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM: Your Twilio WhatsApp sender number e.g. +14155238886
_setupNotes.SALES_WHATSAPP_NUMBER: Sales rep WhatsApp number in E.164 format e.g. +1234567890
